# @web-ts-toolkit/access-router

> ACL-aware Express/Mongoose routers, in-memory data routes and ordered root batches.
> Requires Node >=22, Express >=5 and Mongoose >=8. The installed README is the guide;
> package.json selects matching CJS/ESM JavaScript and .d.ts/.d.mts declarations.

## Entry points

- Root `@web-ts-toolkit/access-router`: default `acl` (shared runtime; named `acl` is identical), named `createAccessRuntime()` (isolated API), routers, guards, validators and public policy/configuration types. The factory's `api.runtime` is its AccessRuntime owner.
- `@web-ts-toolkit/access-router/advanced`: request/service/wire types, parsers, symbols and enums; no runtime factory or standalone Service export. Acquire services through an initialized router/request.
- `@web-ts-toolkit/access-router/processors`: named copyAndDepopulate/copyPaths/movePaths/sliceArrays/countPaths/maskPaths and their option/output types.
- [Imports and CJS form](README.md#import-styles) · [Full public exports](README.md#main-exports) · [Typed processor example](README.md#subpath-import-example)

No per-call/wire selector or retired flag aliases.

Complete workflow is compiled/executed from installed public imports.

## Business and migration contracts

- [Document-permission dependencies](README.md#document-permission-dependencies-breaking-change): alwaysSelectFields is removed, no alias/setter. Root/advanced export ModelDocPermissionsDescriptor/Definition/AccessRecord. Functions or { dependsOn?, get } directly or per-access/default/custom; active docPermissionsAccess exact→default only, no output-access dependency union. Top-level persisted schema keys only (whole nested containers); dotted/unsafe/unknown/virtual inputs reject. Missing inputs never skip get; dependencies grant no output. Whole-definition dotted setters, no partial member edits. Owning embedded facts, independent related/pre-/post-write stages; raw helpers never calculate hooks or fetch inputs.
- [Model-condition guards](README.md#model-condition-guards): private fresh visible-row/fact read, no DTO/field/virtual/include-output/metadata/decorate/task work or `_read` override interception. Source/fact/necessary-input errors remain 400; ordinary denied/missing is 401. Same defaults/projection/hydration/hook source and target-input admission. Request-only service admission is distinct from generated HTTP READ operation admission; captured LIST retry only for an admitted miss. Security belongs in operation/row/fact hooks; a separately checked normal DTO read adds its explicit cost. See shipped M2/M3/M5 migration.
- [Server-owned hydration and migration](README.md#breaking-release-server-owned-hydration): root/advanced types `HydrationMode` and `ModelHydrationOptions`; model/starting-default `hydration` has exactly publicList (built-in lean), publicRead/find/findOne/findById (built-in hydrated). Records replace shallowly; exact dotted setters update one member. Fresh calls capture their owning runtime; in-flight calls keep theirs. Move `defaults.*Options.lean`/`service.defaults` deliberately to model-wide configuration (true → 'lean', false → 'hydrated'); legacy method-default controls throw. No per-call/client/wire replacement; stale permissive keys are inert, strict correlated options still reject, and business fields keep their meaning.
- [Fixed/related modes and value caveat](README.md#breaking-release-server-owned-hydration): includes/post-save subdocument visibility stay lean; raw parents/lifecycle documents stay hydrated; $$sq uses target public configuration; populate inherits its parent query. Plain finalized results do not imply identical schema defaults/getters/transforms/init-hook values or a measured speedup.
- [Finalized permissions alias](README.md#finalized-permissions-alias): non-enumerable value alias to already-exposed canonical metadata, including dotted paths, independent of hydration/plugin. Stripping suppresses it; business/virtual/include collisions win. Package copies preserve it where metadata exists; no metadata synthesis or arbitrary-copy/client-wrapper promise. The optional Mongoose raw getter is separate.
- [Trusted service authorization](README.md#trusted-service-authorization) · [Request admission](README.md#public-request-admission-and-backend-options): policy is server-only; wire/default control slots reject it.
- [Selection, grants and document results](README.md#selection-grants-and-document-results) · [Runnable Mongo authorization example](README.md#runnable-service-authorization): DTOs/metadata are DATA, never reusable authority. Raw helpers use global permissions + frozen empty facts and add zero reads/hooks; current document-dependent authority requires a new normal query (+1 read/hook for a single-row refresh).
- [Independent mutation input](README.md#independent-mutation-input-authority) · [Scoped subdocuments](README.md#dedicated-subdocument-authorization) · [Successful hidden-write responses](README.md#subdocument-writes-with-hidden-responses)
- [Row scope vs query transformation](README.md#backend-row-authorization-and-filter-migration) · [Denial vs miss](README.md#denial-and-request-validation) · [Whole-value distinct](README.md#distinct-whole-value-request-authorization)
- [Removed overrides migration](README.md#breaking-release-service-overrides-migration) · [Named helper migration and data compatibility](README.md#breaking-release-named-helpers-and-default-behavior)

- [Optional raw collections](README.md#optional-raw-collections-one-deliberately-shared-capture): model Service/PublicService (both getters) and Core expose `pickAllowedFieldsMany(rows, access, options?)` (Core prepends modelName), reusing server-only OutputFieldOptions; no DataService/HTTP/client API. One entry actor/model/catalog/config/scope/policy capture is NOT N fresh picks or a default handle/H3 migration. All sources owned before first predicate; independent row EMPTY stages/memos in all modes, no DB/doc hooks/virtuals/row or target admission/restoration. Ordinary presentation normally uses zero helpers; current facts need a new normal READ/LIST with private hook inputs. Dense ordinary 0–1,000-position arrays, nullish preserved; per-row 20,000/depth-100 owners plus whole-call 200,000 work / 16 MiB cumulative router-controlled admission/staging/traversal/copies. EXCLUDES opaque Mongoose/native internals/dependency allocations, trusted effects and engine enumeration; NOT total-memory/RSS/whole-normalization/CPU/sandbox cap. Admit normalized returns before next explicit router copy; explicit native/wire preparation still counts. Bounded shared gate, stable order, sticky whole 400/close/drain/clear (predicate-body errors omit fields), no partial results/rollback/retry. Root/advanced type-only FilteredOutput<T>: deep optional readonly strings, nullish arrays, string Map-to-record, canonical Date/RegExp/Buffer; other BSON/hydrated (including string IDs)/depth-eight unknown. Readonly is not native freeze/input validation/exact field inference. See exact installed M3 recipes; no measured speedup or old-gate substitution.
- [Includes/count cardinality](README.md#include-cardinality) · [Bounded numeric Map counts and Set-to-number migration](README.md#numeric-grouped-count-service-api-breaking-migration) · [Source/attachment provenance](README.md#safe-include-output-paths)
- [Correlated includes and literal escapes](README.md#correlated-includes) · [Nested writes and trusted hooks](README.md#nested-updates-and-trusted-hooks)
- [Virtuals, literal-filter preservation and output compatibility](README.md#virtuals-computed-fields) · [Request/runtime reentrant hook chains](README.md#hook-admission-and-reentrant-service-calls) · [Separate persistence limits](README.md#persistence-concurrency-and-resource-limits)
- [Private populated dependencies](README.md#private-populated-dependencies) · [Runnable example](README.md#runnable-private-dependency-example): server virtual `dependsOnPopulate: [{ path, select? }]`, automatically retained scope-local static ObjectId ref/1D array, eagerly registered same-runtime/same-connection target. Explicit `ModelVirtualDescriptor<Source, Value, { ref: Target }>` types only optional getter argument four (`populated = {}`); argument one/local dependsOn and persisted/write/public types stay unchanged. Root/advanced types: ModelVirtualPopulateDependency, ModelVirtualPopulateInputs. No client/query authority or new entrypoint.
- [Runtime populate operation policies](README.md#runtime-populate-operation-policies): exactly `requireOperationAccessForPopulateQueries` and `requireOperationAccessForPopulateDependencies`, optional booleans on ModelRouterOptions/DefaultModelRouterOptions, owned by the actual TARGET. Resolve each target override → captured runtime model default → builtin true; explicit undefined restores inheritance, omission keeps overrides, only primitive false bypasses a gate (other malformed non-undefined JS is true). Other model options also inherit live defaults, with shallow replacement of nested objects. Valid model/default bulk/exact and router setters; stale `GlobalOptions`/`api.setGlobal*`/global `api.set` placements throw actionable migration diagnostics, never alias/broadcast. Project refs Document use Document Q/D; Document's private User inputs use User D. One runtime/request can have different Document/User/Report pairs. Defaults captured before source/target option reads/awaits; nested stages retain the token/captured targets, later existing-service calls refresh and observe live defaults without overrides. getModelOptions/router construction snapshots retain raw flag overrides, not effective policy; getModelOption resolves live defaults. No query/HTTP/client capability; same-spelled business fields remain data.
- [Operation boundaries and actual-model binding](README.md#runtime-populate-operation-policies): Q=false skips only ordinary target effective read/list/trusted custom admission; source entry/field authorization, target fields/document grants, rows/base/override, original `select`/`_id`, match and mandatory refs remain. D=false skips only private target base read; declared inputs use the selected source virtual's own output policy and request read-row/IDs remain. Four Q/D pairs independent per TARGET; direct/generated/root target access stays denied. Every target needs the actual owning-runtime registered/configured model and effective object permissionSchema (defaults allowed, {} closes business fields). Ordinary string refs resolve on source.db and must match that configured instance; missing/mismatch is controlled bad_request before reads/writes. Explicit same-runtime registered Model-valued cross-connection ordinary refs are supported; the validated model stays pinned in flight even if db.models changes. No caller model/authority on Populate wire. Private declarations remain one-hop static string ObjectId/1D arrays, same connection; no cross-connection/private recursion.
- [Reference reconstruction](README.md#target-authority-selection-and-reconstruction) · [Breaking migration](README.md#breaking-release-populate-policy-migration): no additional target-base-read reference-visibility gate. Adding a virtual does not change ordinary refs. Source unselected/field-denied -> omit; no admitted public population -> exact original IDs/arrays/nulls/missing IDs/order/duplicates/presence, even on strict private denial or private row/query/getter failure. Admitted population -> original authorized mask, scalar null/filtered-array misses (not IDs). Compatible positive fetch unions retain separate immutable public/private masks and request read-row scope, independent of public match/access/related grants. Each getter sees only its declared fourth-argument mask; no implicit DTO/handle/metadata/hook/snapshot/task transport, only its authorized deliberate return. No recursive private target virtuals or successful-write retries. Removed old flags have no aliases/raw mapping; see the migration note. README covers error guards/static validation/native isolation/hydration caveats and measured batching.
